verdict.rationale: Vue's official site links a dedicated "Migration from Vue 2" guide, which covers the move between the incompatible Vue 2 and Vue 3 major versions. Community comments note Vue 3 redesigned its public API while keeping users happy, which supports a managed transition. The evidence, however, is only the link title. missing for 10: details of the guide's content and depth (breaking-change coverage, migration build/tooling), hands-on or independent corroboration that the guide eases migration.
